payload.title: Sensitivity to events
payload.summary: This notebook aims to recreate Figure 6 from a publication by applying the Linear Event Response Model (LERM) to a synthetic 8.2 ka event. It utilizes various scientific computing libraries to process and visualize paleoclimate data. The notebook loads data from a LiPD file, processes it, and generates a production-quality figure. The focus is on analyzing the sensitivity of climate events using a synthetic dataset.
goals: Recreate Figure 6 from the original publication
Apply LERM to a synthetic 8.2 ka event

section_blurbs.blurb: The notebook focuses on recreating a specific figure from a publication by applying the Linear Event Response Model to a synthetic climate event. It involves loading and processing data from a LiPD file and generating a visualization to analyze event sensitivity.
